marketing_description: The DeWALT DW08802CG Cross Line Laser Level features a self-leveling design and projects a green cross-line laser for visibility. This cordless tool has a working range with detector of 55 ft and an accuracy of 1/4 in at 30 ft, and includes a magnetic bracket and hang hole for various mounting options. The DW08802CG also has a locking pendulum and overmold housing for drop protection.
